references.text: Earlier in the chapter, the concept of cities of refuge is established, where a manslayer can seek protection.
Describes the purpose of the cities of refuge: to protect someone who has killed another unintentionally from the avenger of blood.
Previous verse stating that the manslayer must remain in the city of refuge until the death of the high priest.
Next verse explaining the consequence of leaving the city of refuge: the avenger of blood may kill him without guilt.
Parallel text in Deuteronomy regarding the cities of refuge and protection for one who has killed unintentionally.
Joshua's implementation of the laws concerning the cities of refuge, including the procedure for seeking asylum.
